plainLanguage: Leander uses the 2021 International Residential Code and energy code and the 2023 electrical code, adopted by Ordinance 25-034-00 with city amendments. Most new homes are zoned SFU (Single-Family Urban: lots at least 7,200 sq ft, homes at least 1,200 sq ft) or SFS (9,000 sq ft lots, 1,500 sq ft homes). Exact setbacks depend on the zoning 'components' and your plat, so check your plat. A three-car front garage needs a lot at least 60 ft wide. Impact fees are significant: about $8,762 for water and $2,301 for sewer on lots platted after August 2023, plus a roadway impact fee. Western Leander is over the Edwards Aquifer, so subdivisions there carry state (TCEQ) water-quality plans. Big trees need mitigation if removed.
